# Complete Contoso retail test fixture

Owner-authorized public test fixture for GitHub Windows/Linux integrations. Contains the fully populated disposable P7 Contoso report and referenced semantic-model cache; does **not** contain machine-local settings, credentials, login tokens or screenshots. No Azure/Power BI service login is needed for structural tests.

Unpack `contoso-retail-complete-p7.zip` into a temporary directory. Validate with the pinned official Microsoft authoring CLI; expected: 0 errors and 1 inherited legacy-map warning. This file must not be treated as evidence that Desktop runtime and DAX semantics were executed on GitHub.
